description.pt: Motor de automação híbrida (Web via CDP e Desktop Windows nativo via UIA) para agentes autônomos de IA via Model Context Protocol (MCP). Apresenta Reader Mode semântico via AXTree com 92.2% de economia de tokens de contexto e suíte de auditoria defensiva de QA.
description.en: Hybrid automation engine (Web CDP & native Windows Desktop via UIA) for autonomous AI agents powered by the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Features a semantic AXTree Reader Mode delivering 92.2% context token savings alongside a defensive QA audit suite.

description.pt: Business OS e cockpit multi-agente Local-First de alta performance. Conta com isolamento de sessões com Git Worktrees, 18 canais IPC, telemetria em tempo real, editor TipTap modular, transcrição local via Whisper AI e servidor MCP nativo.
description.en: High-performance Local-First Business OS and multi-agent cockpit. Features session isolation via Git Worktrees, 18 IPC channels, real-time telemetry, TipTap modular editor, local Whisper AI transcription, and native MCP server integration.

description.pt: Experiência de computação espacial e realidade virtual em Unity/C# voltada à visualização imersiva de topografia e conscientização ambiental interativa.
description.en: Spatial computing and virtual reality experience built in Unity/C# designed for immersive 3D topographical exploration and interactive environmental education.

description.pt: Gerador NoCode de propostas comerciais corporativas com editor visual drag-and-drop e renderização dinâmica baseada em JSON Schema. Arquitetura full-stack integrada a bancos relacionais e gateways de faturamento.
description.en: NoCode commercial proposal generator featuring a drag-and-drop visual builder and dynamic JSON Schema rendering engine. Full-stack architecture integrated with relational databases and billing gateways.
